subject: MAP orchestration checkpoint — SDK / Auth / Streaming / Toolcall
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Kapoor <ravi.kapoor@cloudwave.io>, CloudWave Integrations <integrations@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP orchestration checkpoint — SDK / Auth / Streaming / Toolcall

Hi Ravi / CloudWave team,

Per our MAP cadence this week I wanted to run a short tactical checkpoint focused on the critical integration pieces blocking close: SDK integration, auth handshake, streaming reliability and the tool-calling contract. Agenda (15–20m):

- Quick status (what's green / at risk)
- Open technical blockers and who is owning next step
- Demo sync window & data needed for the eval plan
- Roll to close timeline and any procurement gating items

Current asks before Wednesday's standup:
- Ravi: confirm whether your security team needs the expanded auth-spec.yaml we attached (deadline Tue EOD).
- Marissa: confirm whether the SDK patch we proposed can be added to the 1.2.1 branch for validation (owner: Marissa).
- Jordan: set up a 30m streaming repro session with CloudWave on Thurs — please propose slots.

Attachments: MAP-v1.3.pdf (mutual action plan w/ milestones), auth-spec.yaml (auth handshake + cert rotation notes), sdk-instruments.patch (small diff for SDK backpressure).

If we can't hit these asks this week the expected close slides ~2 weeks (push to 11/02). If everything lands we stay on target for ~10/28.

Thanks — looking forward to the quick sync.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Ravi Kapoor <ravi.kapoor@cloudwave.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, CloudWave Integrations <integrations@cloudwave.io>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP orchestration checkpoint — SDK / Auth / Streaming / Toolcall

Karthik — thanks for the clear agenda. Quick status from our side:

- Auth: our security team reviewed the initial spec. They want the expanded auth-spec.yaml you attached with explicit JWT rotation examples and an HSM keying note. Can you drop the expanded file by Tue morning? (owner: Redwood)
- SDK: we validated the SDK on a stubbed endpoint. Backpressure behavior looks good but need the patch applied to 1.2.1 branch to test at scale. We could run a load check Friday. (owner: Marissa)
- Streaming: we are seeing intermittent reconnects after ~2.5k tokens in our staging stream. We'll capture logs during the repro. Jordan — a Thu slot at 11:00–11:30 PT works for us.
- Toolcall: we have one question about error semantics on timeout (should be 202 vs 504). We'll add a short note in the shared doc.

We attached a short recording of a failing stream case (demo-screencap-20261021.mp4) and our internal ticket id: CW-TKT-1187.

If Redwood can provide the expanded auth-spec with HSM notes and the SDK patch on 1.2.1 by Tue/Wed, we can hit the 10/28 close. If either slips more than 48h we will likely need to move to early Nov.

- Ravi
Ravi Kapoor
Head of Integrations, CloudWave
ravi.kapoor@cloudwave.io
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Kapoor <ravi.kapoor@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP orchestration checkpoint — SDK / Auth / Streaming / Toolcall

Thanks Ravi — confirmed Thu 11:00–11:30 PT for the streaming repro (calendar invite sent). Action items I can take immediately:

- I'll provision a staging instance with extended logging and token sampling and share the ingest endpoint (owner: Jordan)
- Marissa, can you confirm whether we can cut a 1.2.1 build with the SDK patch by Wed EOD? If not, tell us what you need from CloudWave to expedite.

On the toolcall semantics: I agree that 202 vs 504 needs to be explicit in the MAP. Monica — can you draft the single-line policy we can merge into the MAP doc?

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Kapoor <ravi.kapoor@cloudwave.io>, CloudWave Integrations <integrations@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP orchestration checkpoint — SDK / Auth / Streaming / Toolcall

Appreciate the quick responses — short recap and owners (please reply if anything mismatched):

- Expanded auth-spec with HSM/JWT rotation examples: owner = Redwood (Karthik/Marissa). ETA: 2026-10-20 23:59 PT. (attachment: auth-spec.yaml)
- SDK patch to 1.2.1 and CI build: owner = Marissa Cole. ETA: 2026-10-21 EOD; hold for run Friday load test.
- Streaming repro + logs session: owner = Jordan Blake. Meeting Thu 11:00 PT. Ticket: CW-TKT-1187.
- Toolcall timeout semantics: owner = Monica Patel. Monica to add single-line policy to MAP and we'll merge by Wed.
- Demo/video for eval plan: CloudWave to provide an API key-limited demo recording to validate throughput patterns (attachment placeholder: demo-screencap-20261021.mp4).

If all ETAs hold we remain targeting 2026-10-28 for close and pilot kickoff. If any item misses >48h we will re-evaluate to early Nov and update HubSpot.

Next sync: Thu streaming repro; quick MAP status check Fri if needed.

Regards,
Karthik
